description: The snapshot-bundle lineage manifest written beside every snapshot bundle by sync/make_snapshot_bundle.sh (field-for-field from the script's manifest writer at the pin). The snapshot commit's parent is the current origin tip and its tree is the tree being shipped — never the local lineage. Size + SHA-256 are recorded here before transfer and verified after; the apply route is fetch the snapshot commit, then merge --ff-only.
title: Snapshot-bundle manifest (<bundle>.manifest.json)
